messages:
mia: Quick sync — OSS deep-dive webinar landing + lead routing. Goal: Feb webinar, get 200 signups, route high-intent leads to AE queue. Planning notes below.

sam: timeline?

mia: Landing page + registration by next Tue (2/20). @jordan can we get the registration form + UTM tracking?

jordan: Yep. I'll spin up a Formstack form and add hidden fields for utm_source/medium/campaign. Will post embed code when ready.

priya: For content, let's highlight the refapp and a 15-min live walkthrough + Q&A. Need one benchmark slide (latency/cost) and 2 mini tutorials.

asha: I'll draft the benchmark narrative. Want it to emphasize cost/perf tradeoffs and "how we got 2x throughput" section. :muscle: 

sam: Lead routing: we should route enterprise emails (@company) and high token-volume signups to AE queue. Others go to nurture.

mia: Agreed. Proposed logic:

```
if email_domain in enterprise_allowlist OR answers['intended_use']=='prod' OR utm_campaign contains 'enterprise' => route_to: sales_ae_queue
elif answered 'request_demo'==true => route_to: sales_ae_queue
else => route_to: nurture_marketing
```

jordan: Can push to webhook. Example payload:

```
POST /hooks/leads
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "name": "{{name}}",
  "utm_campaign": "{{utm_campaign}}",
  "company": "{{company}}",
  "route": "sales_ae_queue"
}
```

(note: real webhook will use auth header)

priya: For tracking, let's add a hidden radio for 'primary_use' with values: prototyping, production, research. That helps filter.

sam: QA checklist for routing:
- test enterprise domain
- test demo request
- test utm_campaign
- ensure retries on webhook fail

mia: @jordan can you add retry logic and Dead Letter queue? maybe 3 retries with exponential backoff.

jordan: yep. Will implement 3 retries + log to cloudwatch devrel-leads-dlq.

asha: Marketing assets: hero image, 1 benchmark slide, 3 tutorial GIFs. I'll create a Figma file and share.

mia: webinar logistics: Host: Mia, Demo: Asha, Benchmarks: Asha, Q&A: Priya. 45 min total.

sam: Promotion: community post, twitter thread, partner co-promos. Need copy draft by Thurs.

mia: I'll draft email + tweet thread. @priya can you review messaging for dev audience vs enterprise? We want two variants.

priya: On it — will prepare two subject lines and 3 opening hooks.

jordan: Registration embed ready: <iframe src="https://forms.example.com/123" />

mia: Perf test: remember to include a short reproducible benchmark snippet in the refapp repo. Asha, can you add that to the repo?

asha: yes, adding a 'benchmarks/mini' folder with scripts.

sam: One more: inbound lead SLA: sales to acknowledge AE-routed leads within 24h. Can ops add to SLO docs?

mia: Noted. I'll add to the launch checklist. Final items next week, quick triage call Tuesday 10am PT? :calendar: 

priya: Works for me.

jordan: ok.

sam: :+1:

mia: thanks everyone — will update the doc and ping when assets are in. :tada:
